title: 3.4 Auto Mode and Prediction
concept: Automatic AVL rebalancing and rotation prediction
objective: Before each incoming key is inserted, predict which rotation type ([LL], [RR], [LR], [RL], or [None]) the AVL tree will perform!
start_status: Predict the rotation type ([LL], [RR], [LR], [RL], or [None]) before inserting the incoming key!
hints: Mentally place the incoming key as a BST leaf and trace upward: if no ancestor reaches |BF| = 2 choose None; if one does, compare the two steps from that ancestor toward the new key (LL, RR, LR, or RL).
